frame.converter: Each sky position onto the plane the picture stands on, facing the Sun (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: Cepheid variables of M106 from Yuan et al.'s (2022) Hubble catalogue: one dot per star at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way Cepheid layer's color, size and opacity. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
